target_customer: Medical billing / revenue cycle management teams and healthcare provider groups
problem: Medical billers spend time on repetitive click-work and data entry in revenue cycle tasks (claim status, appeals, payment posting).
business_model: B2B AI agents (an AI-native BPO for healthcare revenue cycle management); site advertises contingent pricing

founders.name: Inderpal Singh
founders.background_notes: Led special projects teams at AngelList and HotelTonight (YC page). A search found no independent source for his role beyond the YC page.

founders.name: Ayo Omojola
prior_employers: Bank of America (bond and FX trading)
founders.background_notes: Per a March 2026 Stedi spotlight he saw claim denials and manual follow-up at Carbon Health during the pandemic, and LLMs made automation feasible. Crunchbase lists him as co-founder and CEO.

technical_complexity.rationale: Browser/portal-driving agents across thousands of payers is standard engineering with hard integration parts; site claims 3,500+ payers.

defensibility.rationale: Payer workflow coverage can accumulate but agent approaches are copyable; no evidence read on moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not shown in sources. By 2025-26 many AI-agent RCM startups (Candid Health $120M Series D, Amperos Health, Charta Health, SuperDial) were funded, but these are later entrants and do not show an incumbent copying Substrate.

market_need_then: Founder says he saw claim denials, slow follow-up and manual work weigh on provider revenue cycles at Carbon Health during the pandemic, and that LLMs made automation feasible (Stedi spotlight, 2026-03).

identity.voice_and_tone: Outcome and savings oriented (more, faster, lower, easy)

brand_strength.rationale: Real-word name shared with several unrelated companies named Substrate (an enterprise AI API from 2024 and others), so searches mix them up; no press about the brand itself found.

outcome_analysis: Substrate, YC S24, sells AI agents that automate claim status, eligibility and other revenue cycle work for physician groups. April 2026 press releases (Business Wire) announce new agents and the company claims over 500,000 claims a month, and the founder is a former Carbon Health product chief with domain insight. No funding, exit or shutdown was found, and the claims are vendor-reported, so the outcome is unresolved while many AI RCM competitors raised large rounds after 2024.
notes: Funding: aggregator pages disagree (an $8M seed dated June 2024 belongs to a different company, Substrate of Rob Cheung, per VentureBeat; VCBacked shows $500K pre-seed; Caplight about $8.98M); none verified for this company, so no round is recorded. Competition: searches found no source dated near the S24 batch; Thoughtful AI launched RCM agents in 2024-11 (hitconsultant), after the batch, and is not listed. Customer volumes are vendor-reported. YC page team size 2 may be stale. Name origin not found. The Business Wire release dates from 2026-04.
